_readme: §PER-CITY-MEASUREMENTS (L-662) — the three EXPENSIVE C63 axes (LEGISLATION 25 · ENVELOPE 20 ·
HEIGHTS 10 = 55 % of the ratified weight) are AUDITS, not config reads, so computeScorecard.mjs
will not score them without a committed, reviewable measurement record. Absent ⇒ not-assessed.
This is the FIRST such record in the repo; before it, every city reported '—' on all three and
the board could not see work that had actually shipped.
⚠ `status: 'measured'` is the ONLY key that unlocks an axis. Never set it to make a number appear.
⚠ Every figure below is CITED to an artefact or a probe. INV-3: cited derivation, never a guess.

envelope.denominator: private buildable land = 75.145 M m² (L-656 — buildable land, NOT all land, NOT clicks)
envelope.source: tools/murcia-coverage-crosstab/out-crosstab.json (2026-08-01, run against the live Murcia GeoServer BEFORE the signature so the number could not be flattered by it)
note: ⭐ UPDATED 2026-08-02 — SIG-MU2 SIGNED, WIRED AND MEASURED. The street-width slice moved from
`no-pack` to `estimated-ruleset`, but only for the part that ACTUALLY RESOLVES.
23.51 pp  packed + PGOU-direct (SIG-MU1)                       → renders
+  4.52 pp  RC/RM/RN via constructed street width (SIG-MU2)      → renders
= 28.03 pp of buildable land rendering; axis = 0.2803 × 0.4 = 11.21 %.
⚠⚠ THE 4.52 pp IS MEASURED, NOT THE 8.81 pp GROSS. `tools/murcia-street-width-probe/probe.mts`
(area-weighted, n=150 rings / 0.590 km² of the 7.845 km² in-force RC/RM/RN population, seed
20260802, run end-to-end through the PRODUCTION resolvers against the live GeoServer) measures
51.3 % resolving. The remainder REFUSES: 44.6 % `band-edge`, 3.4 % `no-opposing-frontage`,
0.7 % `needs-eje-comercial`. Founder 2026-08-02: 'Publish measured coverage only. Never publish
theoretical maximums.' 8.81 pp and 32.32 % are UPPER BOUNDS and are not scored here.
⚠ The 44.6 % is a fact about MURCIA: Art. 5.3.3's decisive threshold is 8 m and the median
governing section on RC/RM/RN land is 8.78 m — the band edge sits mid-distribution. ADR-0287
requires the refusal; it is the doctrine working, not a defect.
⚠ AND IT CANNOT BE SNAPPED AWAY. ADR-0275's snap gate was re-run for Murcia's own quanta
(`snapGate.mts`, 18 854 measurements / 3 693 blocks / 20 tiles): NOT ONE candidate quantum
reaches ×1.0 — the highest is ×0.58, against Barcelona's ×7.55/×7.51/×6.23. No cluster ⇒ no
snap ⇒ raw measured width. The one available upside is closed by the data.
⚠ ASSUMPTION, STATED NOT BURIED: the 51.3 % is measured over ALL in-force RC/RM/RN geometry and
applied to the PGOU-direct subset the dispatch reaches. The rate is a property of street
geometry rather than of delegation status, so this is reasonable — but it is an inference.
Original SIG-MU1 derivation, unchanged:
packedAndDirect_pct 23.51  → a computed envelope RENDERS (§MURCIA-ENVELOPE-RENDER, SIG-MU1)
pgouDirect_pct 33.00 − 23.51 = 9.49  → of which 8.81 pp was street-width-blocked; SIG-MU2 now
converts 51.3 % of that, leaving 4.97 pp unpacked
delegated_pct 67.00  → the PGOU expressly delegates (Arts. 5.24/5.25/5.26/6.2.2/6.5.1/6.6)
⚠ THE TIER IS THE AUTHORISATION, NOT A CHOICE. SIG-MU1 authorises `estimated-ruleset` (weight
0.4) and states `authoritative` is UNREACHABLE — a constructed determination caps at 0.70. So the
arithmetic maximum for this axis is 0.3300 × 0.4 ≈ 13.2 %, and today it is 0.2351 × 0.4 ≈ 9.4 %.
⚠ THE 67 % IS `not-determined`, AND THAT IS THE CORRECT SCORE, NOT A PENALTY. Those parcels reach
a TERMINAL state — a cited `derived-plan` refusal naming the governing article. Under the ratified
definition of CLOSED they are closed; they simply are not envelopes. C63 §1.5 / L-656: a refusal is
a correct answer, and a correct answer is not an envelope. Scoring it above 0 would claim coverage
the law does not grant.

coverage.zoneCode: packed-and-PGOU-direct (14 transcribed calificaciones on non-delegated soil)
RC/RM/RN via CONSTRUCTED street width (SIG-MU2, signed+wired 2026-08-02) — MEASURED 51.3% of the 8.81 pp resolves
RC/RM/RN that REFUSE (band-edge 44.6% / no-opposing-frontage 3.4% / needs-eje-comercial 0.7%) + 0.68 pp residual
legally delegated to a derived instrument (cited refusal — terminal, never an envelope)

note: DENOMINATOR = 34, the buildable calificación FAMILIES the live Murcia GeoServer returns over the
30030 extent (classify.mjs BUILDABLE_FAMILIES = 14 packed + 8 genérica + 4 remitida + 8
refused-direct), NOT the 14 we authored. Scoring cited/authored would report 100 % — the
'Barcelona-borrow' trap C63 §3 Axis 2 names. 14/34 = 41.2 %.
✅ documentInRepo: TRUE since 2026-08-01 (L-676). corpus/pdf/PGOU-MURCIA_TR-2012-12_vol11_normas-
urbanisticas.pdf — 205 pp, 2 352 553 bytes, SHA-256 ab71c651…, embedded title 'TR PG vol_11   NN
UU.signed.pdf'. Every per-parameter verbatim quote is now re-readable from corpus/ exactly the way
Barcelona's DOGC 4893 is.
⚠⚠ THE PRIOR REASON WAS WRONG, AND THAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE FLIP. This block used to say
'urbanismo.murcia.es/infourb/documentos/ returns HTTP 403 … the BCNROC pattern'. The 403 is on the
DIRECTORY INDEX; the PDF returns HTTP 200 to plain curl. No route, no browser, no hand-fetch was
ever needed. The contradiction was already in the repo — esMurciaPgou2012.ts:12 records '(HTTP 200,
2 352 553 bytes)', the exact byte count now filed. Probe the ARTEFACT, not its container.
✅ supersessionChecked: TRUE, and the result is NEGATIVE (no drift). Method in corpus/INDEX.md §2:
pdftotext both consolidations, strip page furniture, segment on 'Artículo X.Y.Z.', hash each article
body, compare. ALL 22 cited zone articles are BYTE-IDENTICAL — every packed zone, every cited
refusal, and both delegation clauses. The 4 cited articles that differ (1.1.1, 5.1.5, 5.26.3, 6.2.2)
move no published value. ⭐ AND THE WORRY WAS BACKWARDS: the murcia.es '2017 re-edition' is the
EARLIER text (the 2012 TR carries Arts. 2.1.10 + 6.2.7/zone ZE which it lacks; its own Art. 5.1.5
cross-references 'Capítulo 22' against its own 'CAPÍTULO 24' heading, which the 2012 TR corrects).
'act. 28_02_2017' is a file-upload label. PRYZM cites the LATER of the two published texts.
⚠ THE SCORE DOES NOT MOVE, AND IT SHOULD NOT. 14/34 = 41.2 % is unchanged: both flags are
EVIDENCE-QUALITY flags that computeScorecard.mjs renders as caveats on the derivation string, not
as multipliers (verified in the code, not assumed). What changed is that the 14 are now PROVABLE.
⚠ AND THE TEMPTING RE-READ IS REFUSED. The 8 refused-direct families (RC RM RN MZ RB RU RT MX) each
carry an article + a verbatim quote that the filed PDF now proves, so counting them would report
22/34 = 64.7 %. C63 §3 Axis 2's INPUT is 'rows carrying a full citation (value·unit·article·
document·URL)' — a refusal has no value·unit row. Those refusals are CORRECT ANSWERS (C63 §1.5,
L-656) and they are scored where they belong, on ENVELOPE as `not-determined`/`no-pack`. Re-reading
the metric to absorb them would be raising a percentage by redefinition, which is the one thing
this record exists to prevent.

heightsLod.source: tools/context-height-probe/probe.mjs against the SHIPPED R2 tiles (same bytes the browser reads, same provenance ladder) — 2026-08-01, verdict `unmeasured`
note: ⚠ measured-lidar = 0. Murcia is the WORST of the five Spanish cities: 96.1 % of its context
buildings render a FABRICATED 9 m default. The 86 `tagged` are OSM-surveyed heights, not MDS
samples — no measured-lidar marker exists anywhere in the city's shipped tiles.
ROOT CAUSE FOUND AND FIXED 2026-08-01: Murcia was absent from heightSources.mjs MDS_CITY_BBOXES,
which is BOTH the join's priorityBboxes AND its retainBboxes working set (L-659). Footprints
outside the retain set stream through untouched, so Murcia could never have been stamped — and a
national bake would still have reported a GREEN §MEASURED-HEIGHT-GATE for the `spain` region.
⚠ THIS RECORD IS A PRE-BAKE BASELINE, DELIBERATELY. A buildings re-bake is in flight; re-probe and
update this block after it publishes. Do NOT edit these counts to predict the outcome
(§SIZE-IS-NOT-PROVENANCE — a green bake is precisely what L-658 produced while shipping nothing).
↳ RE-PROBED READ-ONLY 2026-08-02 (L-676): `probe.mjs --at 37.9922,-1.1307 --name murcia` returns the
SAME distribution byte-for-byte — 3012 footprints, 0 measured-lidar / 86 tagged / 30 derived-levels
/ 2896 assumed, assumedFraction 0.961, verdict `unmeasured`, 20/20 tiles read — against the SAME
tileset version `buildings.pmtiles?v=L659a`. So the bake had not published to R2 as of that probe
and the baseline stands UNEDITED. Nothing here was adjusted to anticipate it.
